content: If SecOCTxSecuredPduCollection is used, then SecOC shall transmit the Secured I - PDU as two messages: The original Authentic I - PDU and a separate Specification of Secure Onboard Communication AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 45 of 161 Document ID 654 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SecureOnboardCommunication - AUTOSAR confidential - Cryptographic I - PDU. The Cryptographic I - PDU shall contain all Authentication Information of the Secured I - PDU, so that the Authentic I - PDU and the Cryptog raphic I - PDU contain all information necessary to reconstruct the Secured I - PDU.

If SecOCTxSecuredPduCollection is used, then SecOC shall transmit the Secured I - PDU as two messages: The original Authentic I - PDU and a separate Cryptographic I - PDU. The Cryptographic I - PDU shall contain all Authentication Information of the Secured I - PDU, so that the Authentic I - PDU and the Cryptog raphic I - PDU contain all information necessary to reconstruct the Secured I - PDU.
